title: Autograph types
description: How a signature was applied to an autographed card.

terms.label: On-card
terms.description: Signed directly on the card stock.

terms.label: Sticker auto
terms.description: Signed on a separate sticker affixed to the card.

terms.label: Cut signature
terms.description: A signature cut from another document or item and embedded in the card.

terms.label: Buyback
terms.description: A previously issued card bought back by the manufacturer, signed, and reinserted into a later product.
